metadata.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer, summarized agency data (NIBRS), https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/LATEST
metadata.geometry: Census TIGERweb Incorporated Places (tigerWMS_Current layer 28), simplified
metadata.rateDefinition: reported offenses / FBI agency population x 100,000; null unless all 12 months were reported

offenseGroups.violent: FBI violent crime (murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault)
offenseGroups.property: FBI property crime (burglary, larceny-theft, motor vehicle theft, arson)

metadata.zipMethod: share of a 40x40 grid of points inside each ZCTA that fall within each city limit; cities under 5% omitted; outsideCityShare = county/unincorporated area
